Self.Wiki: This map object represents an in-game object of varying sizes, from clutter to cliffs. Supports in-built collision, however not all objects use it.

CollisionTypeOverride.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param Collision Type: 11 to 16 use that type, 0 uses the param's, anything else gives Default.

UnkT02.Wiki: When set, the asset's instance gets a helper struct and joins a geometry manager list. 1 on one retail asset.

UnkT08.Wiki: Always 0 in retail. The game treats it as a pointer to a linked list of entries.

UnkT10.Wiki: A condition on a flag from the owning object: 0 always, 1 only when set, 2 only when not set, 3 never.

UnkT11.Wiki: If enabled, when this asset is destroyed, any other assets adjacent (touching) this asset will also be destroyed.

ExcludeActivateRatioOverride_PS4.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param's PS4 exclude activate ratio when not 0. Only used by the PS4 build.

AssetSfxParamRelativeID.Wiki: The SFX ID for this object to use (added to the base ModelSfxParam ID).

UnkT28.Wiki: Read as four shorts; each non-zero one is registered with the sound manager for the asset's map.

PickUpItemLotParamID.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param pick-up item lot (ItemLotParam_map) when greater than 0.

BreakItemLotParamID.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param break item lot (ItemLotParam_map) when greater than 0.

PartNames.Wiki: The part names associated with this collision.

UnkT50.Wiki: When OFF, an asset whose collision type is 0, 11 or 12 is put in group bit 0 of its geometry instance's group mask. ON for 8,097 retail assets.

UnkT51.Wiki: A category, 0, 1 or 2. 1 and 2 put the asset into separate instance lists of the geometry manager. Only set on large assets in the open-world distant-view maps.

ExcludeActivateRatioOverride_XboxOne.Wiki: Overrides the asset geometry param's Xbox One exclude activate ratio when not 0. Only used by the Xbox One build.

UnkT54PartName.Wiki: The part names associated with this collision.

UnkModelMaskAndAnimID.Wiki: A model mask and animation ID that determines the pose of the current asset.

OverrideCollisionSettings.Wiki: If ON, the asset uses its own collision settings below instead of those of the collision in its Part Name [5] (or [4]).

AssetStruct1_Unk04.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x26.

DisableTorrentAssetOnly.Wiki: If ON, Torrent cannot be summoned on this asset.

OpenChrActivateThreshold.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Open Character Activate Threshold.

AssetStruct1_Unk0C.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x37.

AssetStruct1_Unk10.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x38.

AssetStruct1_Unk1C.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x30.

EnableFastTravelEventFlagID.Wiki: If this event flag ID is OFF, fast travel is blocked when on this asset. The asset's own value of the collision setting.

LocationTextID.Wiki: ID of location text to display when stepping onto this asset. The asset's own value of the collision setting.

AssetStruct1_Unk28.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x1C.

PlayRegionID.Wiki: Used to determine invasion eligibility. The asset's own value of the collision setting.

OverrideCollisionGparamSettings.Wiki: If ON, the asset uses its own gparam settings below instead of those of the collision in its Part Name [5] (or [4]).

AssetUnkStruct3_Unk08.Wiki: A gparam sub-ID; the asset's own value of the collision's scene gparam Unknown: 0x1C. Only used by MSB versions before 0x31.

GparamOverride.Wiki: Overrides the gparam with this sub-ID. mXX_XX_AABB This value replaces BB in the gparam file lookup. 255 for none.

AssetUnkStruct3_Unk0A.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x34.

AssetUnkStruct3_Unk0B.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's scene gparam Unknown: 0x1D.

AssetUnkStruct3_Unk0C.Wiki: A gparam sub-ID; the asset's own value of the collision's scene gparam Unknown: 0x20. Usually equal to Gparam Override.

AssetUnkStruct3_Unk0E.Wiki: The asset's own value of Collision Unknown: 0x4C.

TimezonePlayerLightScaleOverride.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Timezone Player Light Scale Override: 1 on, 2 off, 0 keeps the map's value.

PlayerLightScale.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Player Light Scale. Negative keeps the map's value.

DisableWhenMapLoadedMapID.AltName: Disable Asset on Loaded Map ID
DisableWhenMapLoadedMapID.Wiki: Disables the asset when the specified map is loaded.

MapGridCreateHeightDetailLimitInfoID.AltName: Map Grid Height Detail Limit Info ID
MapGridCreateHeightDetailLimitInfoID.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Map Grid Height Detail Limit Info ID.

OverrideCollisionSoundSettings.Wiki: If ON, a character standing on the asset uses the Outdoor/Indoor Type and Easy Occlusion ID below; otherwise those of the collision the asset refers to.

OutdoorIndoorType.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Outdoor/Indoor Type: 0 outdoor, 1 half indoor, 2 fully indoor. 255 keeps the default.

EasyOcclusionID.Wiki: The asset's own Collision Easy Occlusion ID (Wwise EasyOcclusionID state _N).
